About

Technology, analysis, and financial systems thinking.

I'm a Computer Science and Data Science undergraduate at NMIMS MPSTME, Mumbai, interested in the intersection of intelligent systems, statistical analysis, software engineering, and quantitative finance. I enjoy turning raw data into meaningful insight, building machine-learning models that solve practical problems, and writing software that makes complex systems easier to work with.

My interests span data analytics, predictive modelling, financial technology, algorithmic research, risk analysis, and full-stack development — developed through coursework, independent projects, and research-style experimentation. I'm building toward competitive roles in data science, AI/ML engineering, and quantitative finance, with organisations like Deloitte, JPMorgan, KPMG, and EY in mind, and a longer-term interest in postgraduate study in the UK.

Selected Work

Projects & research

A mix of coursework, independent research, and hackathon concepts — each labelled by actual status rather than presented as finished product.

AI-Powered Financial Fraud Detection & Risk Scoring

In Development

Reinforcement-learning / multi-agent mini project for the AAI course: four agents trained with tabular Q-learning (IQL) for fraud classification and risk scoring on the real ULB/Worldline credit-card transactions dataset (~284,807 transactions, 492 labelled frauds).

PythonFastAPIStreamlitReinforcement Learning

ML Algorithmic Trading Research

Ongoing Research

A research repository exploring systematic trading strategies with a focus on rigorous methodology — ablation studies, interpretability, and robust, leakage-aware backtesting rather than headline returns.

PythonPandasBacktesting

TradeIntel AI — Real-Time NIFTY 50 Signal Platform

Specification Phase

Designed as an analysis and paper-trading research tool (not an auto-execution system): 15-minute BUY/SELL/HOLD signals for NIFTY 50 stocks via an ML ensemble with walk-forward validation, live trading disabled by default.

React/TSFastAPIPostgreSQLXGBoost/LightGBM

CYCLONE-X

Hackathon Concept

Smart India Hackathon concept for an AI/ML cyclone identification, classification, and alerting platform combining satellite and meteorological data (NASA GPM/IMERG, NOAA, IBTrACS, IMD) into interpretable, geo-located risk alerts.

FastAPIPostGISRedisReact / Next.js

Real-Time Market Data Visualization

In Development

A TradingView-style charting and visualization build targeting sub-second update latency for live market data display.

JavaScriptWebSocketsData Viz

Quant Market Risk Engine

Planned

A future project extending the trading research line into volatility, drawdown, and portfolio-risk measurement across gold, silver, and Indian index data.
